verdict.rationale: Reverse ETL is a fair axis for a data-integration platform like Airbyte, so it applies. However, the evidence describes data flowing into warehouses, lakes and databases ('Consolidate data from hundreds of sources into your data warehouses'). Nothing documents syncing modeled warehouse data out to CRM, ads or support tools as destinations. Agent 'act on your data' features are a different capability and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an analytics engineer, I sync modeled warehouse data back into SaaS tools (CRM, ads, support) to activate it where teams work
